label: Categories
when: the post categories as a list or a dropdown, to browse the blog by topic
rules: One self-closing comment, no inner blocks. It lists the site's categories that have posts, each linking to its page, so never write category names or links. "showPostCounts":true adds the number of posts; "showHierarchy":true nests subcategories; "showOnlyTopLevel":true lists only the top ones. "displayAsDropdown":true shows a select instead of a list, with "label" as its text (default "Categories"; "showLabel":false hides it). A list gets a heading above it, a dropdown does not. Never set "taxonomy" or "showEmpty".
example: Topics
